symbols.name: first input value
symbols.meaning: The first of the two input values that the butterfly maps.
symbols.quote: Let $u$ and $v$ be two input values, and let $H_0$ denote the butterfly map, so that $H_0(u,v)=\left(\frac{u+v}{2},\frac{u-v}{2}\right)$.

symbols.name: second input value
symbols.meaning: The second of the two input values that the butterfly maps.
symbols.quote: Let $u$ and $v$ be two input values, and let $H_0$ denote the butterfly map, so that $H_0(u,v)=\left(\frac{u+v}{2},\frac{u-v}{2}\right)$.

symbols.name: butterfly map
symbols.meaning: The two-point map sending a pair of values to its half-sum and half-difference.
symbols.quote: Let $u$ and $v$ be two input values, and let $H_0$ denote the butterfly map, so that $H_0(u,v)=\left(\frac{u+v}{2},\frac{u-v}{2}\right)$.

symbols.name: identity matrix
symbols.meaning: The $2\times 2$ identity matrix, which leaves every pair unchanged.
symbols.quote: Squaring the matrix gives $H_0^2=\frac14\begin{pmatrix}2&0\\0&2\end{pmatrix}=\frac12 I$, where $I$ denotes the $2\times 2$ identity matrix.

relations.quote: The butterfly is a scaled length-2 case of the [discrete Fourier transform](fourier-transform.md).
